sets.title: State or Action?
sets.description: Choose the correct position verb: state (where something is) vs action (placing it there)
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильный глагол: состояние или действие

items.prompt: Ваза _____ на столе уже три дня.
items.promptEnglish: The vase has been standing on the table for three days.
items.hint: The vase is currently in an upright position. That is a state, not an action.
items.explanation: Стоит (state) describes the vase's current upright position. No one is placing it right now.

items.prompt: Мама _____ цветы в вазу.
items.promptEnglish: Mom put the flowers into the vase.
items.hint: Someone performed the action of placing the flowers upright.
items.explanation: Поставила (perfective action) means she completed the act of placing the flowers upright into the vase.

items.prompt: Книга _____ на полке рядом со словарём.
items.promptEnglish: The book is lying on the shelf next to the dictionary.
items.hint: The book is flat on a surface. That is a state of lying.
items.explanation: Лежит (state) describes the book's current flat position on the shelf.

items.prompt: Я _____ документы в ящик стола.
items.promptEnglish: I put the documents into the desk drawer.
items.hint: Someone performed the action of placing documents flat into a drawer.
items.explanation: Положил (perfective action) means the speaker completed placing the documents into the drawer.

items.prompt: Картина _____ на стене в гостиной.
items.promptEnglish: The painting is hanging on the living room wall.
items.hint: The painting is currently in a suspended position. That is a state.
items.explanation: Висит (state) describes the painting's current suspended position on the wall.

items.prompt: Рабочий _____ новую люстру в зале.
items.promptEnglish: The worker hung a new chandelier in the hall.
items.hint: The worker performed the action of hanging the chandelier.
items.explanation: Повесил (perfective action) means the worker completed the act of hanging the chandelier.

items.prompt: Гости _____ за столом и ждут ужин.
items.promptEnglish: The guests are sitting at the table, waiting for dinner.
items.hint: The guests are currently in a seated position. That is a state.
items.explanation: Сидят (state) describes the guests' current seated position at the table.

items.prompt: Официант _____ нас за лучший столик.
items.promptEnglish: The waiter seated us at the best table.
items.hint: The waiter performed the action of seating someone.
items.explanation: Посадил (perfective action) means the waiter completed the act of seating the guests.

items.prompt: Телефон _____ на диване. Не забудь его!
items.promptEnglish: The phone is lying on the sofa. Don't forget it!
items.hint: The phone is flat on a surface right now.
items.explanation: Лежит (state) describes the phone's current flat position on the sofa.

items.prompt: Не _____ ноги на стол!
items.promptEnglish: Don't put your feet on the table!
items.hint: This is a prohibition: don't perform the action of placing. Use the imperfective imperative for negative commands.
items.explanation: Не клади (imperfective imperative) is the correct form for a negative command. In Russian, prohibitions use imperfective imperatives.

items.prompt: Бутылка _____ на столе рядом со стаканом.
items.promptEnglish: The bottle is standing on the table next to the glass.
items.hint: An upright object at rest. That is a state.
items.explanation: Стоит (state) describes the bottle's current upright position on the table.

minimalPairs.context: Ваза _____ на окне. (describing where it is now)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The vase is standing on the windowsill.
minimalPairs.explanation: Стоит (state) describes the vase's current upright position. Поставили would describe the action of placing it.

minimalPairs.context: Вазу _____ на окно. (describing what someone did)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: They put the vase on the windowsill.
minimalPairs.explanation: Поставили (action) describes placing the vase upright. Notice the accusative вазу and на + accusative окно for direction.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The coat is hanging on the hook.
minimalPairs.explanation: Висит (state) describes the coat's current suspended position.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: They hung the coat on the hook.
minimalPairs.explanation: Повесили (action) describes hanging the coat. Note на + accusative вешалку for the direction of placement.

minimalPairs.context: Ребёнок _____ на стуле и рисует. (current position)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The child is sitting on the chair and drawing.
minimalPairs.explanation: Сидит (state) describes the child's current seated position.

minimalPairs.context: Ребёнка _____ за парту. (the teacher placed the child)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: They sat the child at the desk.
minimalPairs.explanation: Посадили (action) means someone seated the child. Note accusative ребёнка and за + accusative парту.

sets.title: Sort and Fill In
sets.description: Categorize objects by their natural position verb and fill in the correct forms
sets.descriptionRussian: Распределите предметы по глаголам положения и заполните пропуски

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these objects by which position verb describes their natural resting state

blanks: Молоко _____ в холодильнике на верхней полке. (The milk is standing in the fridge on the top shelf.)
Журналы _____ на журнальном столике. (The magazines are lying on the coffee table.)
Зеркало _____ в прихожей над вешалкой. (The mirror is hanging in the hallway above the coat rack.)
Кот _____ на подоконнике и смотрит на птиц. (The cat is sitting on the windowsill, watching birds.)
_____ сумку на стул, пожалуйста. (Put the bag on the chair, please.)
Мария _____ тарелки в шкаф после ужина. (Maria put the plates into the cupboard after dinner.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Choosing the correct position verb by object orientation and state vs action
hints: A carton or bottle stands upright.
Flat items like magazines lie on a surface.
A mirror is attached to a wall - it hangs.
An animal on a surface is typically in a seated position.
Someone is asking you to hang the bag. Use the perfective imperative.
She completed the action of placing plates upright. Past tense, feminine.
explanations: Стоит - milk cartons stand upright in the fridge.
Лежат - magazines are flat objects that lie on surfaces.
Висит - a mirror on a wall hangs (is suspended).
Сидит - animals in a resting position 'sit' in Russian.
Повесь - perfective imperative of повесить. You hang a bag on a chair back.
Поставила - she placed the plates upright into the cupboard (feminine past perfective).

items.prompt: Which verb describes the natural position of a painting on a wall?
items.promptEnglish: Which verb describes the natural position of a painting on a wall?
items.hint: A painting is attached to a wall, suspended.
items.explanation: Висит - paintings hang on walls. They are suspended, not standing or lying.

items.prompt: Тарелки _____ в шкафу на полке.
items.promptEnglish: The plates are standing in the cupboard on the shelf.
items.hint: Plates stored upright on a shelf are in a standing position.
items.explanation: Стоят - plates stacked or stored upright on shelves 'stand' in Russian.

items.prompt: Собака _____ у двери и ждёт прогулки.
items.promptEnglish: The dog is sitting by the door, waiting for a walk.
items.hint: An animal waiting in an alert resting position sits.
items.explanation: Сидит - dogs in a resting but alert posture 'sit' in Russian.

sets.title: Transform and Correct
sets.description: Convert between state and action descriptions and find errors in position verb usage
sets.descriptionRussian: Переведите описание из состояния в действие и найдите ошибки

errorCorrection.sentence: Ваза лежит на столе рядом с цветами.
errorCorrection.hint: A vase is an upright object. Which verb describes upright position?
errorCorrection.explanation: A vase is tall and upright, so it стоит (stands), not лежит (lies). Лежит would mean the vase is on its side.

errorCorrection.hint: Documents go flat into a folder. Which action verb is for flat placement?
errorCorrection.explanation: Documents are flat and go into a folder horizontally, so the correct verb is положил (placed flat), not поставил (placed upright).

errorCorrection.sentence: Картина стоит на стене в спальне.
errorCorrection.hint: A painting on a wall is suspended, not standing upright.
errorCorrection.explanation: A painting attached to a wall висит (hangs). Стоит would mean it is standing upright on a surface, like propped against something on the floor.

errorCorrection.hint: Placing a person onto a chair is seating, not hanging.
errorCorrection.explanation: Посадила (seated) is the correct action verb for placing someone in a sitting position. Висеть/вешать refers to hanging objects.

errorCorrection.sentence: Кот лежит на стуле и смотрит в окно.
errorCorrection.hint: An alert animal watching something is in a sitting posture, not lying down.
errorCorrection.explanation: An alert cat watching birds сидит (sits). Лежит would mean the cat is stretched out flat and relaxed. The phrase 'смотрит в окно' suggests an alert, upright posture.

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ книгу на полку. (completed the action of placing it flat)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I put the book on the shelf.
minimalPairs.explanation: Положил - placing a book flat on a shelf. Поставил would mean placing it upright (spine visible).

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ книгу на полку. (placed it upright, spine out)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I stood the book up on the shelf.
minimalPairs.explanation: Поставил - placing a book upright on a shelf so the spine faces out, like in a library.

minimalPairs.context: Бельё _____ на верёвке. (current state after being hung)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The laundry is hanging on the line.
minimalPairs.explanation: Висит (state) describes the laundry's current position on the clothesline.

minimalPairs.context: Бельё _____ на верёвку утром. (the action of hanging it up)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: They hung the laundry on the line in the morning.
minimalPairs.explanation: Повесили (action) describes the completed act of hanging the laundry on the line. Note на + accusative верёвку for direction.

sets.title: Build and Translate
sets.description: Assemble sentences with position verbs and translate between Russian and English
sets.descriptionRussian: Составьте предложения с глаголами положения и переведите

translation.english: The cat is sitting on the windowsill and watching the birds.
translation.answer: Кот сидит на подоконнике и смотрит на птиц.
acceptableVariants: Кошка сидит на подоконнике и смотрит на птиц.
Кот сидит на подоконнике и наблюдает за птицами.
translation.hint: Seated animal = сидит. Location = на + prepositional.
translation.grammarFocus: State verb сидеть for seated position

translation.english: I hung the new curtains in the bedroom.
translation.answer: Я повесил новые шторы в спальне.
acceptableVariants: Я повесила новые шторы в спальне.
В спальне я повесил новые шторы.

translation.english: Don't put the book on the floor! Put it on the shelf.
translation.answer: Не клади книгу на пол! Положи её на полку.
acceptableVariants: Не клади книгу на пол! Положи на полку.
translation.hint: Negative command = не + imperfective imperative (клади). Positive command = perfective imperative (положи).
translation.grammarFocus: Imperfective vs perfective imperatives with position verbs

translation.english: The plates are standing in the cupboard on the top shelf.
translation.answer: Тарелки стоят в шкафу на верхней полке.
acceptableVariants: В шкафу на верхней полке стоят тарелки.
translation.hint: Upright objects = стоят. Location uses prepositional case.
translation.grammarFocus: State verb стоять for upright objects

blanks: _____ пальто на вешалку, когда приходишь домой. (Hang your coat on the hook when you come home.)
Не _____ чашку на край стола! (Don't put the cup on the edge of the table!)
Учитель _____ учеников по парам. (The teacher seated the students in pairs.)
Где _____ мой телефон? (Where is my phone lying?)
Мой телефон? На диване _____. (It's lying on the sofa.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Imperatives and correct verb choice for different positions
hints: A habitual instruction (when you come home) uses imperfective imperative of вешать.
Negative command for placing a cup upright uses imperfective imperative of ставить.
The teacher completed the action of seating students.
A phone on a sofa is flat. Use the state verb for lying.
explanations: Вешай - imperfective imperative for a habitual instruction: always hang your coat when you arrive.
Ставь - не + imperfective imperative (не ставь) for a prohibition. A cup stands upright.
Посадил - perfective past, the teacher completed the action of seating the students.
Лежит - a phone is a flat object lying on the sofa. The state verb лежит describes its current position.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All position verb topics combined in varied exercises
sets.descriptionRussian: Все темы глаголов положения в разных типах заданий

items.prompt: Почему чемодан _____ посреди комнаты? Убери его!
items.promptEnglish: Why is the suitcase standing in the middle of the room? Move it!
items.hint: A suitcase is typically upright.
items.explanation: Стоит - a suitcase is a tall, upright object that 'stands' in Russian.

items.prompt: _____ тарелки на стол, ужин скоро. (Place the plates on the table.)
items.promptEnglish: Put the plates on the table, dinner is soon.
items.hint: Plates are placed upright/flat-upright on a table. Use the perfective imperative.
items.explanation: Поставь - plates are placed on a table in an upright position (ставить). Perfective imperative for a specific one-time instruction.

items.prompt: Где моя сумка? — Она _____ на стуле в коридоре.
items.promptEnglish: Where is my bag? - It's hanging on the chair in the hallway.
items.hint: A bag draped over a chair back is hanging.
items.explanation: Висит - a bag on a chair is typically hanging from the backrest, so it 'hangs' in Russian.

items.prompt: Бабушка _____ в кресле и вяжет шарф.
items.promptEnglish: Grandma is sitting in the armchair, knitting a scarf.
items.hint: A person in a chair is in a seated position.
items.explanation: Сидит - a person in an armchair is seated. This is the state verb for the sitting position.

items.prompt: Я _____ все фотографии на стену в кабинете.
items.promptEnglish: I hung all the photographs on the wall in the office.
items.hint: Photos go on a wall. What verb describes the action of suspending something?
items.explanation: Повесил - the action of attaching photos to a wall is hanging (повесить).

items.prompt: Снег _____ на земле с утра.
items.promptEnglish: Snow has been lying on the ground since morning.
items.hint: Snow covers the ground in a flat layer.
items.explanation: Лежит - snow lies on the ground as a flat covering. This is one of the most natural uses of лежать.

items.prompt: Туман _____ над рекой всё утро.
items.promptEnglish: Fog hung over the river all morning.
items.hint: Fog is suspended in the air above the river.
items.explanation: Висел - fog 'hangs' in the air. This is a common figurative use of висеть for suspended atmospheric phenomena.

items.prompt: _____ ребёнка в детское кресло в машине.
items.promptEnglish: Put the child in the car seat.
items.hint: Placing a child in a seat means seating them.
items.explanation: Посади - the perfective imperative of посадить. Seating a child in a car seat is the action of placing someone in a sitting position.

items.prompt: Велосипед _____ у стены в гараже.
items.promptEnglish: The bicycle is standing by the wall in the garage.
items.hint: A bicycle leaning upright against a wall is in a standing position.
items.explanation: Стоит - a bicycle is an upright object. Even leaning against a wall, it 'stands' in Russian.

errorCorrection.sentence: Зонт стоит на вешалке у двери.
errorCorrection.hint: An umbrella on a hook or coat rack is hanging, not standing.
errorCorrection.explanation: An umbrella hooked on a coat rack висит (hangs). It would стоит only if placed upright in an umbrella stand.

errorCorrection.hint: Glasses go on a shelf upright. They are not suspended.
errorCorrection.explanation: Glasses are placed upright on a shelf (поставил), not hung (повесил). Повесить is for objects that are suspended.

errorCorrection.hint: A coat goes on a hook or hanger. That means it will hang.
errorCorrection.explanation: A coat on a вешалка (coat rack/hanger) is hung, not laid flat. The correct imperative is повесь (from повесить).

patternRecognition.sentence: Ваза стоит. / Бутылка стоит. / Лампа стоит. / Чемодан стоит.
patternRecognition.question: What physical characteristic unites all the objects that 'stand'?
options: They are attached to a wall
patternRecognition.explanation: All these objects are taller than they are wide and rest in an upright position. Стоять is for vertically oriented objects.

patternRecognition.sentence: Книга лежит. / Газета лежит. / Письмо лежит. / Полотенце лежит.
patternRecognition.question: What do all these objects have in common?
options: They are suspended in the air
They are flat and resting on a surface
patternRecognition.answer: They are flat and resting on a surface
patternRecognition.explanation: All these objects are flat and rest horizontally on a surface. Лежать describes a flat, horizontal resting position.

patternRecognition.sentence: State: стоит на столе. Action: поставил на стол. State: лежит в ящике. Action: положил в ящик.
patternRecognition.question: What grammatical change happens to the location phrase when switching from state to action?
options: Prepositional case changes to accusative case
patternRecognition.answer: Prepositional case changes to accusative case
patternRecognition.explanation: State verbs use prepositional case for location (на столе, в ящике). Action verbs use accusative case for direction (на стол, в ящик). This mirrors the Russian location vs direction distinction.
